capabilities: Edit hierarchical mind maps with drag, search and layouts
Link map topics to standalone notes via an automatic bidirectional index
Chat with topics through instruction or free AI modes
Manage multiple OpenAI-compatible models per task
Expose the map to external AI tools via a local MCP service
extras: AI assistant is in a free trial period and will join premium later; not yet on the Marketplace (manual install only); desktop only, mobile unsupported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in mind map that keeps a hierarchy and its notes linked, so structure and cross-links need manual upkeep.

requires.name: Mind Tree premium license (AI currently in free trial)

summary: Mind-map plugin that binds hierarchical maps to per-topic notes, with AI chat, auto-filing and a local MCP service.
